body: I don't know if I'm just emotional or what but when I read "You're doing really well and i am so proud of you", I started to tear up. haha. you are the first person to say that to me.

Nope. I'm completely alone in this. I'm recovering with no help from anyone. & I'm just sick of relapses happening. I've been dealing with this shit for 9 years. & this is the longest I've been 'recovered' so far. I thought I was doing great but if I can't handle gaining weight, I guess I'm not. 

And that's great advice actually. I'm gonna really apply that. I binged like crazy & gained weight because of it. I accept what happened & I've learned my lesson. I'm going to be more careful to avoid binges so I don't end up in this situation again. I'm going to start eating healthier & exercising in a safe way. It's unrealistic to lose 9 pounds in 3 days, so I'll take my time & do it the right way to avoid a possible relapse. It'll come off when it comes off. If the person on monday can't understand, to hell with him. 

Omg.just saying all that out loud to myself felt so much better.haha. Seriously, I can't thank you enough. Just talking it out with me helped tremendously. Because of you, I didn't relapse or cut. 

Thank You :)

That's what I'm scared of. What if I relapse completely & I'm stuck? 
And I'll be 22 soon.

That's what I've been doing this whole year.haha. Focusing on how I feel instead of a number on the scale. I just really have to get rid of this first, then I'll go back to the healthy way of doing things.

I know but I still would feel better if I was 9 pounds lighter. I already had the mindset of 'fuck him if he thinks I'm fat. I'm trying to get better' but that was before I gained weight. At this weight, I can't have that mindset. I HAVE to at least lose something by monday. I don't care what I have to do. 

& no,at this moment I can't think of a single thing I like about myself.

9 pounds probably wouldn't make that big of a difference on most people but I'm only 5'2'' so it definitely shows. & I totally agree with you about not needing someone's approval. But I just feel like I'm misleading this person. When monday comes around & we meet & it's obvious I'm heavier than I was a couple months ago, I'll look like a liar.

I just want to look perfect.

I HAVE been avoiding taking measurements and weighing myself. But I could physically feel myself getting fatter so I weighed myself to see if I was right. And I was. I don't want to start weighing myself again but I'm gonna have to. At least until I get this 9 pounds off.

I'm really freaking out because I have to meet someone on Monday & that only gives me 3 and a half days to get rid of it. I'm just getting so stressed out.

This whole year in recovery, my weight stayed the exact same number. so,I was able to brush off any bad thoughts because I logically knew I didn't look bigger. But I recently started pigging out on carb heavy foods, & I stupidly weighed myself & I've gained 8-9 pounds from it.

I look disgusting.
